name: Evidence EARNS; governance GRANTS; promotion requires BOTH
source_terms: the platform's central mechanism, stated at last
statement: A promotion is the conjunction of two causally independent events: an evidential standing crossing a bar (which nobody can decree) and a governance act recognizing it (which no evidence can compel). Neither alone suffices.
logical_form: promote(k) <-> evidence_standing(k) >= bar AND exists act a: grants(a,k). The two conjuncts have DISJOINT causal engines: no ruling makes an observation Replicated; no evidence makes a document frozen.
assumptions: that evidential and act-driven progression are genuinely independent - F0018 grounds this in TWO pre-existing declared orthogonalities (status|-authority, ADR-status|-maturity) plus GEP-F1, i.e. three prior refusals of the fusion
evidence_basis: Derived from a 10-mechanism inventory (P-1..P-10) answered against seven commissioned questions each, not asserted. Three independent prior canon statements cited as corroboration.
open_questions: PM-2 (should standing-changes get the role/guard treatment status-changes have?)
mathematical_note: This is the first object in 25 files with a clean formal shape: a conjunction over two independent orders. A partial order (evidence, monotonic) x an act log (governance, append-only). Flagged for Step 2 as the most promising formalization target found so far.
validation_obligations: a single observed traversal in which both conjuncts are recorded - see C-0007, which puts the count of traversals itself in dispute

name: Authority = immutable PROVENANCE x mutable STANDING
statement: The single field 'authority' answers two different questions: 'where did it come from?' (provenance: generated, derived - never changes) and 'how much should I trust it?' (standing: authoritative, provisional, historical - changes by governance act).
logical_form: authority = P x S where P is a constant of origin and S is a state changed only by acts. Attestation is a transition in S. Nothing is a transition in P.
assumptions: that authorities.yaml's five values partition cleanly into the two questions - F0018 shows the file's OWN header asks both questions, which is unusually strong internal evidence
evidence_basis: The source schema's own header is the evidence ('how much should I trust this AND where did it come from'). Confirmed by the worked example: a signed financial statement is derived in provenance and authoritative in standing simultaneously without contradiction.
explains: why authority has no state machine while status does (half of it cannot have one)
why the I-4 confusion was persistent (derived was read as entailing low standing)
F0014's mechanically-located asymmetry between statuses.yaml and authorities.yaml
open_questions: PM-1 (should the two questions be separated in the schema?)
mathematical_note: A product of a constant and a state machine. Dissolves a posed question rather than answering it - the corpus's clearest instance of a QUESTION being shown ill-posed.
note: This object DISSOLVED F0014's LG-1. Recorded as a supersession (R-0015), not a contradiction.

name: The unreachability thesis
statement: What prevents the platform from being handed to a second product is NOT missing knowledge but UNREACHABLE knowledge that keeps regenerating itself. A platform whose method is rediscovered rather than retrieved cannot be handed over, because handing it over means handing over retrievability.
logical_form: Not: gap(K). But: exists(K) AND NOT reachable(K) -> regenerate(K'), K' ~ K. Measured by a monotonic occurrence counter.
assumptions: that the nine rediscoveries share one cause
evidence_basis: Nine measured occurrences, three found against the author's own same-day deliverables; four of nine suspected gaps shown not to be gaps. BUT the file's own falsifiable correlation ('all nine drew on UNINDEXED regions') is REFUTED by its own later annotation (C-0006): occurrence #10 drew on an INDEXED region.
revised_causal_claim: The cause is not only a missing index - it is also not reading the index that exists. This materially weakens the proposed remedy (an index), since an index does not fix non-consultation.
open_questions: whether the remedy follows from the revised cause
validation_obligations: the 11 occurrences themselves - none is in the window

name: Engineering Method is a bounded context distinct from Engineering Governance
statement: Governance (D-1) and Method (D-2) are two independently governed models: two constitutions, two ADR series, two baselines, two vocabularies. Treating them as one domain would merge two independently governed models.
assumptions: that an own-constitution + own-decision-series + own-baseline + own-language conjunction is sufficient for a bounded context under Round47-OP's nine admissible justifications
evidence_basis: Originally asserted STRONG on four independent grounds. F0024 downgraded it: 'own ADR series' is a SHARED authority (sponsor + ARB), and the series was authored in one day retrospectively, so independent EVOLUTION is falsified. It SURVIVES on a narrower ground: Round39-D6's explicit scope exclusion ('Governance discoveries MUST NOT appear here').
open_questions: R-1 / the D-1<->D-2 authority relation: are they peers under a common sponsor, or is Method subordinate? F0020 calls this 'the model's most consequential open question' and states no document can settle it.
validation_obligations: ARB ruling on the D-1<->D-2 relation
note: Called 'THE MODEL'S PRINCIPAL DISCOVERY' by its source, then partially falsified within the same day. The clearest example in the corpus of a headline claim surviving on a different ground than the one it was announced on.

name: The boundary runs THROUGH Evidence, not around it
statement: 'Engineering Evidence' is not one domain. Evidence Protocol (harvest question, promotion ladder, observation protocol, saturation gate) is platform-owned and fully reusable; Evidence Records (reports, session logs, H/D registers) are owned by the producing product and never reusable.
logical_form: A concept whose OWNER differs across its parts is two concepts. Split ownership is a boundary, not an ambiguity.
assumptions: that canon's 'owner = the producing track; consumed by DA' cannot be satisfied by a single owner
evidence_basis: The split is not inferred - canon states the dual ownership, and the source says so explicitly.
mathematical_note: A general splitting rule: if owner is not a function (one concept, two owners), the concept is not atomic. Generalizable beyond Evidence - flagged for Step 2.
caveat: D-6a is stated to have 0 traversals - a claim F0015 falsifies (C-0007). If the falsification holds, D-6a's 'never executed' status is wrong.

name: Classification follows the domain model; the model precedes the index
statement: Classifying by artifact kind (workbook, constitution, playbook, report, audit) is 'filename thinking wearing a taxonomy'. An index keyed to today's arrangement inherits today's arrangement. The semantic model must come first.
evidence_basis: Demonstrated rather than argued: the domain model reached the same misfit a vocabulary search had found, AND reached one the search could not (D-6b, product records inside the platform tree) 'because records contain no methodology terms at all'. The source names this 'the demonstration that the model had to precede the index'.
note: This is a METHODOLOGICAL object that directly governs the reconstruction protocol itself: it is the corpus's own argument for why a semantic pass beats a structural pass - the same argument §2 (complete-file atomicity) makes.

name: KnowledgeOS is an engineering-knowledge GOVERNANCE platform that happens to use ontologies
statement: Not an ontology engineering platform. The primary comparison literature is knowledge governance, evidence/provenance and policy enforcement; ontology engineering and KG engineering are upstream suppliers of techniques.
evidence_basis: Three-sided: (1) INTERNAL - the programme repeatedly demoted ontology to candidate knowledge while governance concepts hardened; (2) EXTERNAL-CONVERGENT - every strongly-validated edge is a governance edge (R-2, R-5, R-8); (3) EXTERNAL-GAP - a fetched provenance-ontology survey names human authority over evidence as the literature's own blind spot, which is the layer KnowledgeOS occupies.
status_note: Explicitly CANDIDATE. Adoption is the sponsor's positioning act (U-GR-1), and is blocked behind D-5 (the mission is unratified). The corpus REFUSES to adopt its own positioning statement because the ordering would be inverted.
note: The most important self-description of KnowledgeOS found in 25 files, and the corpus declines to adopt it. For Step 2 this is the leading candidate answer to 'what problem is KnowledgeOS solving?'

name: KnowledgeOS governs retrieval architecture and competes with none of it
statement: KnowledgeOS is upstream policy; retrieval engines (RAG, GraphRAG, KG, vector search) are downstream enforcement surfaces. A supplier relationship, not a rivalry.
logical_form: governance (PAP) -> capability (PDP) -> retrieval boundary (PEP). The industry's 'enforce before ranking' places the PEP exactly where R-7 already put it.
evidence_basis: Independent convergence: the industry rule 'the unauthorized chunk never enters the candidate set' matches the corpus's deny-at-boundary enforcement, arrived at separately. Verbatim external support for the Boundaries!=Triggers correction ('advisory UX is not governance').
open_questions: U-GR-3 (does 'Retrieval Boundary' enter the ubiquitous language?)

name: Ubiquitous-language collision load
statement: Twelve terms carry multiple senses. 'Baseline' carries FIVE; 'Constitution' FIVE+; 'Capability' THREE; 'Platform' FOUR; 'Governance' THREE, one of which is product-side.
measurement: 12 terms measured, not asserted; severity graded CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM.
evidence_basis: Each sense is cited to a distinct artifact.
open_questions: R-2 (put the Baseline five-way collision to the ARB)

This object predicts exactly the identifier-collision hazard §4A and §19A exist to handle, and it is independently confirmed by SOURCE-LOCAL-IDENTIFIERS.jsonl, which found FOUR distinct meanings of the 'D-' series across F0006, F0013, F0015 and F0020. The corpus measured its own collision problem and the reconstruction hit the same problem from the other side.

name: A deployment IS a nested Knowledge Space
statement: PRODUCT vs DEPLOYMENT needs no new concept. A deployment has its own bindings and a declared boundary, and the ontology already permits a Knowledge Space to contain other Knowledge Spaces. Knowledge Spaces nest.
evidence_basis: Closes the open question H-3 on evidence rather than preference, adding nothing to a frozen ontology.
mathematical_note: Recursive containment. The only self-similar structure found in 25 files.
note: An instance of a recurring corpus move: a proposed new concept DISSOLVES under checking. Same shape as T-0014 dissolving LG-1, and F0016 dissolving the proposed Provenance Domain.

name: The monotonic occurrence counter
source_terms: my fourth instance of level confusion
statement: The corpus maintains running integer counts of recurring failure modes, incremented in place as new instances are found, and reported as evidence.

The counter can: F0019's annotation (#10) strictly precedes F0015's D-2 (#11). This is a CONTENT-DERIVED ordering signal that is strictly finer than the date signal, and the reconstruction found it only because §2 required complete-file reading.
assumptions: that the counter is global across the corpus and never reset or forked - NOT yet verified; if two tracks maintain separate counters the ordering is invalid

I-5 one authoritative artifact per topic (lint-enforced)
I-11 knowledge does not EXECUTE; capabilities execute

honesty_cost_recorded: F0026 notes that broadening R-6 to the composite 'makes it HARDER to prove, not easier'.

name: A running instance of instruments-produce-authority-accepts
recovery_basis: F0028 is not a document about a system; it contains records FROM one.
statement: 10 recommendations issued, 1 decided, time-to-decision 6.5 hours, held in recommendations.jsonl and decisions.jsonl with intra-day timestamps. Issuance, decision and rationale are separated in practice, not only in specification.

findings.RD-6: ACTOR PROVENANCE GAP: the decision record's actor stamps the git user, but the decider was the AI at the user's direction - when AI participates in decisions, the actor model needs to distinguish who-executed from who-authorized.
findings.RD-7: FIRST ANOMALY: a recommendation CAN currently be decided twice; two identical ACCEPTED records exist. The corpus instructs: do not patch the guard before the semantics are decided.

learning_event_completeness: 3 of 5 - recommendation, decision, rationale present; commit and outcome absent.
significance_reason: First file in 30 that is operational evidence rather than specification or review. RD-6 is I-14 (machine confidence != epistemic authority) meeting reality, reached independently by the corpus.

name: Survival does not entail sufficiency
recovery_basis: F0029 section 2 records the MVK bootstrap as an executed test, not a thought experiment.

name: The adopted mission (M-A) and the designed-for mission (M-B)
recovery_basis: F0031 Part 1 states both and marks exactly one ADOPTED.
statement: Two mission statements exist in canon. M-A (AIP-14, ADR-AIP-02, R-23) is ADOPTED: 'the platform exists solely to improve delivery of PublicDigit'. M-B (Product Discovery Charter) is PROPOSED, UNAPPROVED, explicitly a hypothesis: an AI-native Knowledge Operating System sold to organizations.
adopted_mission_full: KnowledgeOS exists to improve the delivery of PublicDigit by governing how engineering work is planned, approved, executed, verified and evolved - in a form that is independent of project, programming language and execution provider.
resolution_of_apparent_contradiction: AIP-14 constrains WHY work is undertaken; the Reference Architecture constrains WHAT is built. A cost control, not a boundary.
the_finding: Almost every architectural difficulty in this track is a symptom of designing under M-B while governed by M-A.
significance_reason: This is a FOURTH answer to 'what is KnowledgeOS', it is the only ADOPTED one, and it reframes the other three as possibly symptoms of an unresolved mission conflict (MQ-1).
